_comment: (spec §5.5 the anchor-stone-per-region idiom -- the #10/#12/#16 contract) Each row is one fast-travel DESTINATION: {id, display_name, map, cell, requires_accomplishment, arrival_toast}. `requires_accomplishment` gates the row at >= 1 (the door_when/contains_when >= semantics); a future region milestone appends a row keyed on ITS OWN attunement accomplishment, zero code (src/core/portals.gd's WIPortals.attuned_destinations/build_portal_graph read this list generically). v1 ships the Liscor pair: the inn's pantry_door <-> the street's street_anchor_stone, both gated on door_awakened (they attune together -- the SAME beat-4 awakening opens both ends of the player's own home-region connection). Arrival cells are blast-radius-checked walkable + off every canonical route (the DP3 discipline): inn (13,6) is the free interior cell immediately west of pantry_door (14,6, moved against the east wall by playtest hotfix #2 -- was (10,6)/(9,6)); street (29,10) is the open mid-street cell immediately west of the new street_anchor_stone (30,10), clear of every blocked/decor/entity cell on that map.

portals.arrival_toast: Cold light, gone as fast as it came. The gate district's noise rushes back in around you.
Warm air, woodsmoke, the creak of the pantry door settling shut behind you. You're back, and you didn't walk here.
The light warms and the air smells of wheat and river water before you've taken a step. Riverfarm, same as the rumor said.
portals._comment: 8b R1 (issue #10) -- the anchor-stone-per-region idiom's first genuinely NEW instance (zero code, per this file's own top-level comment). riverfarm_attuned banks from the Guild-board rumor beat (guild_board's own board_rumors list in skeleton_scene.json, read at THE REQUEST BOARD -- deliberately NOT a bounties.json posting, since that pool's size is load-bearing for every canonical seed's rotation window), not from any door-awakening beat -- a new region earns its OWN attunement, distinct from the Liscor pair's shared door_awakened. Arrival cell (13,5) sits one cell east of riverfarm_anchor_stone (12,5) at the village's own end of the pair, open + off every blocked/decor/entity cell on that map (blast-radius checked).

portals.arrival_toast: The light turns pale and cool, and the noise of a much bigger city rushes in to fill the silence. Invrisil, same as the letter promised.
portals._comment: The anchor-stone-per-region idiom's newest instance (zero code). invrisil_attuned banks from Eloise's stone purchase (riverfarm_witch.json's 'shop' node, post-blight_lifted) -- the Guild-board letter (guild_board's own board_rumors list in skeleton_scene.json) stays a signpost only, pointing at Riverfarm/Eloise rather than banking this flag itself. Arrival cell (4,8) sits one cell east of invrisil_anchor_stone (3,8) at the boulevard's own end of the pair, open + off every blocked/decor/entity cell on that map (blast-radius checked).

portals.arrival_toast: The light sharpens and the air turns to hot metal and stone dust. Pallass, tier on tier, rising past where you can see the top.
portals._comment: 8e Phase C ('Papers for Pallass' Stage 2, controller ruling 2, the GH#65 late-attuning precedent -- invrisil's own row above is the template). pallass_attuned banks from Krshia's attunement-stone purchase (data/dialogue/krshia_crate.json's 'charms' node, gated on pallass_sponsored), the SAME late-attuning shape as invrisil_attuned. FORWARD-REFERENCED map/cell: pallass_market and the (10,10) arrival cell do NOT exist in skeleton_scene.json yet -- Phase B's own parallel worktree lane owns pallass_market's actual map authoring (this lane's ownership is quest/portal/dialogue wiring only, per the phase plan's file-ownership split, disjoint from B's skeleton_scene.json). requires_accomplishment gates this row structurally inert (WIPortals.attuned_destinations excludes it) until pallass_attuned banks, which cannot happen before B's map lands (krshia_crate.json's own gate on pallass_sponsored is the only live producer) -- so no canonical QA run selects this row today. CONTROLLER RECONCILIATION REQUIRED at merge: replace (10,10) with B's actual walkable arrival cell (the DP3 discipline -- off every blocked/decor/entity cell, blast-radius checked).
